title: Two years of Project 2025: what got done, what it cost, and who paid
dek: The Heritage Foundation’s 900-page plan was disowned by the candidate and executed by the president. By every tracker’s count more than half of it is in place. The Supreme Court has struck down its boldest pieces, its authors run the agencies they wrote about, a quarter of the senior staff has turned over, and the people it reached run from 65,000 immigrants in detention to a school in Minab, Iran.
